mods.description: extend the world border to beyond 30 million

releases.notes: parity support with 1.7.3 or whatever, idk but most if not all of the stuff from that update is here too, except that this version is specifically for 26.4-snapshot-3, the one with the updated F3 UI and the ice caves.

mods.name: there is no border
mods.description: extend the world border to beyond 30 million

releases.notes:
fixed a few bugs

1. blocks couldn't be modified at 33,552,992, now they can be (there's still issues beyond 2^25 though)
2. sometimes the game crashes out of nowhere because of lighting issues or whatever, hopefully that's fixed now
3. removed fabric api and so commands no longer work, but you can press \ and open up a GUI that has everything you need (except for 26.1 players but ill explain that a bit later)
4. farlands are now on by default again

and the big thing about this update, all versions from 26.1 to 26.3 have been unified into a single jar file. it is still recommended to play this with 26.2+ though because 26.1 doesn't have the fancy GUI due to mc being mc. commands for 26.1 are very rudimentary, but ill explain it here:

you type in "tinb" (without a slash) and then "farlands disable" (or false or off) so you get "tinb farlands disable" in chat, and then press enter. while nothing may appear in chat, the game has parsed your command. there are two other commands, "tinb wbmax" that just maxes out the border and "tinb precision <0-100>" that sets how precise your XYZ coords in the position UI are

anyways, this mod is likely still unstable, so yea. have fun!

releases.notes:
support for 26.4-snapshot-3 (nice ice caves)

this version has a lot of fixes and QoL changes!

1. increased max spectator speed from 0.2 to 1 (scroll difference has been increased too)
2. changed position UI yet again to be more "true" to vanilla
3. fixed a crash where a number was 0.00001 smaller than it was supposed to be, or smth like that (yes that really happened and I had to make a whole mixin just to fix it)
4. potentially fixed 2^30 crash, caused by mineshafts. now you should be able to go beyond 2^30 in worlds with structures and hopefully not crash

i think that's it. anyways, happy ice caving! and also this version probably won't work in future snapshots (ik 1.8-pre-1 wouldn't have worked for this snapshot)
